summary_paragraph: Mr. Johnson, a patient with a history of cholangiocarcinoma and biliary stents, was admitted for observation after experiencing bleeding during a routine ERCP stent clean-out. The bleeding, likely due to tumor ingrowth near the stent, slowed but did not fully stop, prompting hospitalization. He remained hemodynamically stable throughout the stay, with no signs of active bleeding, stable hemoglobin, and normal liver function tests. He received one dose of IV meropenem during the procedure and continued on suppressive delafloxacin. His diet was advanced without issue, and he was discharged home the following morning with plans for a repeat ERCP in three months and instructions to monitor for signs of bleeding or infection.
